short_bio: American digital illusionist known for short videos with apparent magic tricks made with editing.
biography:
Zach King makes short videos with visual effects. His trademark is the seamless jump-cut illusion: a shoe becomes a pair of pliers, a person steps through a screen.

He began posting on YouTube in 2008, gained wide recognition on Vine in 2013 with six-second “magic vines”, and later moved to TikTok. The tricks are made with video editing rather than sleight of hand, and the videos loop cleanly.
